messages:
Priya (PM): quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need clear owners and jira links for the action list from the 3/19 outage. can folks claim items today?

Anna (SRE): I can take the autoscaler misconfiguration item, will add a ticket. ETA two weeks? :thumbsup:

Mike (Eng-Infra): I can pick up the GPU routing fallback rule and rollout plan. prefer to split into infra + test tickets.

Sasha (Product): I'll own the customer-facing doc and the rollback runbook updates. can we get deadlines aligned to the remediation sprint (ends 4/5)? @Priya

Priya (PM): sounds good. main constraints: compliance review for runbook by 3/31, and a canary by 4/1. please add JIRA links and RACI entries in the postmortem doc.

Anna (SRE): created ticket `INF-4321` for autoscaler config and added checklist:
```
- reproduce with perf fixture
- add stricter validation on deploy path
- unit test for scale down edge
- rollout + revert plan
```
Assigning to me, marking RACI: R=A, I=Mike, C=Priya, S=Sasha

Mike (Eng-Infra): split into `INF-4322` (routing fallback) and `INF-4323` (integration tests). put me as R on 4322, Anna as C for test infra on 4323. ETA: 1 week for design, 3 weeks for rollout.

Sasha (Product): created `DOC-129` for customer comms and `RUN-77` for runbook. linking both to the postmortem. I'll need a compliance review — @Priya can you trigger?

Priya (PM): done — submitted `RUN-77` to compliance. expected review by 3/30.

JiraBot: Ticket INF-4321 updated: assignee=Anna, due=2026-04-07, labels=[postmortem, priority-high]

Anna (SRE): quick note — can we add an on-call training item to avoid recurrence? propose short checklist + 1-hr session. I'll draft and attach to `INF-4321` as subtask.

Mike (Eng-Infra): agree. also proposing an automated smoke test that runs on deploys touching routing. I'll add steps in `INF-4323`.

Priya (PM): RACI roundup so we have a clear handoff:
- INF-4321 (autoscaler) — R: Anna, A: Anna, C: Mike, I: Sasha
- INF-4322 (fallback) — R: Mike, A: Mike, C: Anna, I: Priya
- DOC-129 / RUN-77 — R: Sasha, A: Sasha, C: Priya, I: Mike
(please confirm or suggest changes)

Sasha (Product): confirm. I'll add acceptance criteria to DOC-129: link to runbook, list of customers to notify, and sample template.

Anna (SRE): confirmed. adding on-call training subtask `INF-4321-1`.

Mike (Eng-Infra): confirmed. I'll add test harness doc and timeline to `INF-4323`.

Priya (PM): final ask — please set the jira due dates consistent with the remediation sprint and tag the postmortem id `PM-310`. I'll close this thread once all tickets are linked. :eyes:

DeployBot: noted deploy tagged `release/2026-03-20` referenced in PM-310.

Anna (SRE): all tickets linked to PM-310, pushed updates. I'll follow up with a short status post next Tue. :rocket:

Mike (Eng-Infra): same, will post progress updates in the ticket comments.

Sasha (Product): thanks — marking as owner for docs. will ping again for compliance when review returns. :paperclip:

Priya (PM): thanks team — closing thread. if anything slips we'll reopen here.
